cohort: The study included mothers who gave birth to singleton term breech babies in selected hospitals in North Shoa Zone, Oromia Region, Ethiopia.
finding: Perinatal mortality was 6.4%, and factors like 5-min Apgar score < 7, prolonged labor, rupture of membrane <12 h, and breech diagnosed during labor were significantly associated with increased perinatal mortality.
cross-section timing: During the perinatal period, around the time of birth and immediate postpartum period, between January 1, 2022 to March 30, 2022.
